Shoreline Mafia Joins @suicideboys On Tour And Had The Crowd Going Crazy In Front Of 18,500 Fans At Their SOLD OUT Salt Lake City, Utah Show 📈🏟️👀

Shoreline Mafia is a Los Angeles rap group that became one of the biggest names in the modern West Coast hip-hop scene. Originally consisting of OhGeesy, Fenix Flexin, Rob Vicious, and Master Kato, the group broke through with their 2017 mixtape ShoreLineDoThatShit and songs like “Musty,” “Nun Major,” and “Bottle Service.” After separating around 2020, OhGeesy and Fenix Flexin reunited Shoreline Mafia as a duo, returning with “HEAT STICK” in 2024 and the album Back in Bidness in 2025. 

$uicideboy$ are a New Orleans rap duo made up of cousins $crim (Scott Arceneaux Jr.) and Ruby da Cherry (Aristos Petrou). They built a huge following through the underground and SoundCloud scenes with their distinctive dark, alternative style and independent approach. The two also founded G*59 Records, and their rise from the underground has turned them into a major touring act with an extremely dedicated fanbase. 

#OhGeesy is a Los Angeles rapper and founding member of Shoreline Mafia. Born Alejandro Carranza, he helped build the group from an underground L.A. movement into a nationally recognized act before establishing his own solo career. His solo catalog includes Geezyworld, Geezyworld 2, and Paid N Full, while he has also worked with artists including Future, YG, Tyga, Kodak Black, and Lil Yachty. He eventually reunited with Fenix Flexin to bring Shoreline Mafia back. 

Fenix Flexin is a Los Angeles rapper and fellow founding member of Shoreline Mafia. He and OhGeesy knew each other years before Shoreline Mafia officially formed, and their chemistry became a major part of the group’s signature sound. Fenix left the group around 2020 and pursued a solo career, releasing projects including his Fenix Flexin mixtape series and Back Flexin. He later reunited with OhGeesy, bringing Shoreline Mafia back as a two-man group.
